create_gtn_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn Graph, add start and accept nodes, then add labeled arcs between them
get_and_set_graph_weights: get graph arc weights as a list or numpy array and set new weights via list or numpy
compare_gtn_graphs_for_equality: compare two gtn Graph objects for exact equality or structural isomorphism using gtn.equal and gtn.isomorphic
save_and_load_gtn_graphs: save a gtn Graph to disk in text or binary format and load it back with gtn.savetxt and gtn.load
run_autograd_backward_on_gtn_graphs: run gtn.add or gtn.subtract on graphs with calc_grad enabled then call gtn.backward to compute gradients
